name: factory-spec
title_zh: 把模糊工厂问题切成四片可执行规格
tagline_zh: 开工前先过四道闸：产品、行为、设计、实现。每个切片都过人工确认，不让你对着空气写代码。
tagline_en: Before coding, slice the vague ask into product, behavior, design, and implementation—each human-approved, so you.
desc_en: Turn an ambiguous factory issue into human-approved product, behavior, design, and implementation slices. Use interactively before implementation.
why_zh: 不是生成一份大而全的文档，而是按决策层级逐片确认，每片独立可审、可改、可弃，把返工成本压到最低。
why_en: It doesn't dump one monolithic spec—it slices by decision layer, each independently reviewable and editable, so rework stays.
limit_zh: 只处理工厂/制造类issue，且必须有人工逐片确认；若你跳过确认直接写码，切片会停在实现层不产出代码。
limit_en: Factory/manufacturing issues only; requires human sign-off per slice. Skip review and it stops at implementation—no code. Not for refactors or tech.
